# Micro QR / rMQR reference vectors

`vectors.json` holds reference symbols (text, version, level, mask and the module matrix) taken from the
test data of [ZXing-C++](https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp) (Apache-2.0, © ZXing authors).
They are used only as an independent oracle by `tests/oracle/micro-rmqr.test.ts`; nothing here is
shipped in the package.
